title: Quick and Easy Pizza Roll
description: Prepared pizza dough is filled with cheese and pepperoni and baked for these quick and easy crowd-pleaser pizza rolls, perfect for parties.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Unroll pizza dough onto the baking sheet and stretch it slightly. Cover evenly with mozzarella cheese. Scatter pepperoni over the cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Roll up the dough starting from the shortest end. Center the roll on the baking sheet. Spray the outside with cooking spray.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Slice and serve with pizza sauce.

video.description: This fun snack recipe could also double as an easy crowd-pleasing dinner. In this video, Nicole makes pizza rolls using a creamy tomato sauce and all of her favorite pizza toppings. Similar to cinnamon roll recipes, the tomato sauce is spread on a layer of pizza dough before being rolled together with everything from sausage and pepperoni to herby basil and mozzarella cheese. After being cut into individual pieces, the rolls are baked in the oven until golden brown and gooey.
